svg.aria-label: Sequence diagram of CopyObject: Client, S3 front, Proxy, Hot tier, Cold tier. The front reads the source with open_read, checks the copy-source conditions against the rendered ETag, chooses the destination attributes by the metadata and tagging directives, and streams the source body into the same put path as any put, which takes the destination entry and checks both tiers; digests are made again in the pass.
svg.title: CopyObject: a read of the source streamed into an ordinary put of the destination
svg.text: CopyObject: a read of the source streamed into an ordinary put of the destination
Client
S3 front
Proxy
Hot tier
Cold tier
0 PUT dst: x-amz-copy-source, x-amz-metadata-directive, x-amz-tagging-directive
1 open_read(src): hot, then cold; no entry is read
2 Meta { size, tag, record } and the body
3 Source missing: 404 NoSuchKey. x-amz-copy-source-if-match / -none-match against the
rendered source ETag: 412. Over copy.max_object_bytes: 400 InvalidRequest.
COPY: attrs and tags of the source. REPLACE: attrs and tags of the request.
4 Accumulator over the source body: every digest is made again (an older source gains them)
5 put_stream_with(dst, len, body, Landing { attrs }): the ordinary put path
6 take dst entry; HEAD both tiers: dst exists is 412 (create-only); land; record; PENDING
7 200 <CopyObjectResult><ETag> (md5 of the bytes) <LastModified>
src = dst: a copy onto itself that changes only the metadata
8 META op on the key: entry (META, HELD), rewrite the record in each tier that holds it
9 cold, then hot; the bytes, the md5 and the ETag do not change
The destination is a new object, so it is written create-only under its own entry like any put: eviction, back-pressure and the cold-direct
landing at Full apply unchanged.
Source and destination bytes pass through the node once each. A copy onto an existing key follows the overwrite rule (gap G10); today that is
